decisions.reason: The compact rotating dumper extends the firm's established range, is presented on its own page as a visible commitment, and has had too little time on the market for any weak results to be seen as more than temporary.
The articulated dumper builds on existing engineering, so dropping it after one year would write off development costs and contradict the firm's publicly presented range extension.

The mine rescue vehicle is distant from the core and so carries more risk, but the substantial specialized investment and its public presentation make management likely to persist and treat slow early uptake as temporary in a long-cycle niche market.
The compact telescopic loader fits the established lifting and construction offer and the firm's announced refinement strategy, and it is too new to judge, so management keeps it.
